note: What a server sends when a unit comes into what one client can see. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: maxHealth
fields.note: What the unit's health tops out at.

fields.name: health
fields.note: What its health stands at. A client holds it to between zero and maxHealth.

revisions.note: It carries no other messages: the body is the unit's health alone, always present.

fields.name: vitals
fields.note: The unit's health. Where a client already holds the unit, it reads these from body offset 2 whatever the carried size, so a server carries messages here only where they create the unit, and sends the vitals right after them.
